status: User-requested anatomy constraint; style preference is not blanket art approval
rules: Exactly four limbs total: two forelimbs and two hind limbs.
Forepaws used as hands are the same anatomical limbs as the front legs; never add a separate pair of arms.
Upright: two hind feet on the ground and at most two front paws at the chest. No third foot or pale stump under the rear quill edge.
Walking: one forelimb pair and one hindlimb pair. Far-side limbs may be occluded; never force four visible feet plus chest paws.
Inspect each panel at close range before presenting. A prompt alone does not verify anatomy.
Preserve the preferred soft miniature materials. Correct anatomy without introducing long human-like legs.
scope: Future Mr. PinPin illustrations; historical source images remain unchanged.
